Name: Jacob
Summary: Jacob was Isaac's son who wrestled for the blessing and became father of the twelve tribes of Israel. God renamed him Israel after a night of wrestling.
KeyStory: At Bethel Jacob dreamed of a ladder reaching to heaven, and years later he wrestled with God at Peniel until daybreak.
RelatedPeople: Isaac; Rebekah; Rachel; Joseph, Son of Jacob
LifeLesson: God took a deceiver and made him Israel, the father of a nation. He is still in the business of giving strugglers a new name and a new future.
Places: Haran; Canaan; Shechem; Bethel; Hebron; Beersheba; Egypt
RelatedEvents: Jacob Wrestles with God; Joseph and His Brothers
